changelog: Adds visibility for the previously-invisible gap between app code (updated via firmware) and manually-deployed system files like autostart (updated via deploy_manual_files.sh, never automatically). The Device tab's Device Info card now shows a separate 'System config' version alongside the app's own Firmware version, read from a new MANUAL_FILES_VERSION file that ships with autostart/environment/etc. and is deployed the same way. deploy_manual_files.sh also echoes the version it just deployed, confirming what shipped at the point of deployment. Shows 'not tracked' rather than a blank/misleading value on a device that's never had this file deployed.
